previousScene.dialogue: Leaves use chlorophyll to capture sunlight and turn water plus carbon dioxide into food for the plant.
previousScene.visualAction: Tutor stands beside a large leaf diagram on the whiteboard and points to the leaf while speaking.

scene.userRequest: Continue the educational story with the exact same tutor character from the previous video. The tutor is continuing the same biology lesson. She now explains how fruits develop from flowers and protect seeds. At the beginning, naturally connect this topic to the previous lesson about leaves and photosynthesis. Include a brief reference equivalent to: “Previously, we learnt how leaves help plants prepare food.” Continue with a friendly, clear Indian English teaching style. Preserve the same tutor's identity, face, clothing, hairstyle, voice, classroom, lighting, teaching personality and visual style. Do not mention the time of day or suggest that this is a different teaching session. Do not introduce a new tutor. Create an approximately 8-second video.
scene.objective: Connect leaves and photosynthesis to the new topic and explain how fruits develop from flowers to protect seeds.
scene.dialogue: Fruits grow from flowers and protect the seeds inside.
scene.visualAction: Tutor gestures toward a simple flower-to-fruit diagram on the whiteboard.
scene.openingBridge: Previously, we learnt how leaves help plants prepare food.
